metadata.description: Three Claude Code plugins: p4-phi, which keeps what linked sessions hand each other and retrieval from the project's own history; p4-temportal, which keeps the project's auto memory in its store by Claude Code's own autoMemoryDirectory, leaves each session's scratchpad to the app, and gives the store's files lifetimes; and p4-native, the host layer, which keeps what this host is and can do where the other two read it.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Keeps the project's auto memory, notebook and saved code in its .claude/p4 store, where Claude Code writes the memory itself by autoMemoryDirectory, leaves each session's scratchpad to the app, clears what is no longer relevant by lifetimes, and keeps a compaction from losing what a session needs.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked Claude Code sessions hand each other, and retrieval from the project's own history: rule and fact lines beside a message or a subagent's task when the ranker is confident, an earlier answer in place of a repeated web lookup, and what worked after a failure an earlier session met.

plugins.name: p4-native
plugins.description: The host layer of ezexe/p4: at a session's start it works out what this host is and can do, the desktop app or a terminal, interactive or scripted, the Claude Code version and the tools that answer here, and keeps that map in the project's .claude/p4 store, where the session and the other p4 plugins read it, and when the Claude Code version changes it probes each condition that blocked a decision and tells the session once what changed, it names each command and tool of a new build that no p4 plugin has weighed, and two native features wait behind options that are off by default.
